title: Nectar de citron (Lemon Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Two kilograms of lemons soaked 5 minutes in water with a little bleach, pressed and filtered; the juice boiled 10 minutes with water and 2 kg of sugar, cooled and bottled.
longDesc: p. 79 of the October 2023 recipe book: 2 kg lemons, 2 kg sugar and 5 litres of water. The lemons are soaked 5 minutes in water with a little bleach, pressed by hand or press, filtered; water and sugar are added and boiled 10 minutes; cooled; ‘add the preservative if possible’ (the preservative is not in the ingredient list and its quantity is not printed); bottled; kept cool. The diagram shows 65 °C for 10 minutes.
ingredients: A little bleach (javel) for the soak — quantity not printed
Preservative (named in the method, not in the list) — quantity not printed
steps: Soak the lemons in drinking water with a little bleach for 5 minutes.
Press by hand or press. Filter.
Add the water and sugar. Boil 10 minutes.
Cool. Add the preservative if possible.
chefTips: The page prints no doneness cue beyond the boil time.
The diagram shows 65 °C for 10 minutes — the time matches, the temperature does not say ‘boil’.
The bleach and preservative quantities are not printed.
commonMistakes: Adding less water than printed and getting a syrup.
storage: Keep cool. No shelf life is printed.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar de citron’ (p. 79). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 25 is a placeholder. TWO-PASS.
CONFLICT (unreconciled): diagram ‘Cuisson (65°, 10min)’ vs ‘boil 10 minutes’ in the text. ABSENT: bleach and preservative quantities; the preservative is not in the ingredient list; shelf life.
